question: How many deluded disputants does Svacchanda count?
premises: in Svacchanda scripture, by that said: of disputants
deluded, Vaishnava and the rest, at night-end
inference: Svacchanda counts 363 deluded disputant schools, Vaishnava-led.
plain_english: In Svacchanda scripture, by that said: of disputants — three hundred sixty-three exceeding, deluded, Vaishnava and the rest, at night-end.
